before: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR makes malformed JSON raise JsonException. Passing true as the second json_decode argument requests associative arrays for objects; the third argument, 512, sets the maximum decoding depth. Valid JSON can also be a scalar or null; successful decoding is not a shape guarantee.

Require an array with an integer minutes field before using it. The null-coalescing lookup handles a missing key. json_encode serializes the accepted structure with the same throw policy. An application range remains a separate check.
